title: Price is high but items are nice. 2 states each month.
text: I'm giving this a 3 star ONLY because of the price. We homeschool and 14 99 a month for just 2 states is a bit much. We pay $8.99 a month for an actual curriculum. I just wanted to get a bit more in depth on the state's for our co-op since I plan in teaching the state's.
label: neutral
